key.name: icon-path
key.description: Absolute path to an image file to use as the panel icon. Empty means use the bundled default icon.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll the usage endpoint.

key.name: credentials-path
key.summary: Override path to Claude Code credentials file
key.description: Absolute path to credentials.json. Empty means use the default ~/.claude/.credentials.json.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show percentage label in the panel
key.description: When enabled, shows the current session percentage next to the panel icon.
